title: factory confinement specification
description: The per-launch model workspace/tool confinement specification (FACTORY-LOOP-SPEC sections 5.1/18; Task 8, schema factory-confinement/v1). It is a pure function of the verified invocation binding and the committed workspace state: role, provider, canonical workspace, bound commit, resolved backend, the fresh sanitized private HOME/XDG environment, and a deterministic deny-by-default allowlist of path rules. The confined-launch child (.factory/loop/confine_launcher.py, staged from its exact committed blob per F2) reads this specification through a bounded no-follow descriptor, builds a Landlock ruleset (one allow rule per entry; everything outside the allowlist is denied for read and write), restricts itself, installs the sanitized HOME/XDG environment, and then execs the secure wrapper. The real confinement proof (workspace_confinement.prove_confinement) binds the SHA-256 of the canonical JSON serialization of exactly this specification, and LaunchSupervision re-validates the proof against the exact specification immediately before exec. Validated by .factory/loop/workspace_confinement.py validate_confinement_spec.
